55713.summary: The class discusses the significance of Jesus Christ's baptism and crucifixion, emphasizing the role of the Lamb of God in atonement and sacrifice. It highlights the humility and obedience of Christ throughout his life, culminating in his crucifixion for the sins of the world.

55714.summary: The class explores Jesus Christ's role as high priest and his obedience through suffering, emphasizing his humanity and the necessity of his temptations and death for atonement. It contrasts this with Trinitarian views, highlighting the Christadelphian understanding of Jesus' nature and mission.

55715.summary: The class discusses Jesus as the great high priest, drawing parallels between his crucifixion and the lifting of the serpent by Moses. It emphasizes the significance of faith in Christ for salvation and the ongoing intercession of Christ for believers.
